correctness.rationale: For each same-side pair a_i,a_j, exactly P_i union P_j distinguishes it, forcing at least two selected landmarks across every two matched pairs and hence at least n landmarks. At equality every matched pair contributes exactly one landmark. The one-hole transversal lemma follows from explicit mixed distance coordinates: vertex and edge codes are individually injective, and the only possible vertex-edge collisions are incident pairs, occurring exactly when one side contributes one or two selected landmarks. Applying this lemma to every one-landmark deletion yields the exact basis condition p=0, q=0, or p,q>=4. Exhaustive computation confirms the full classification for n=4..9.

value.rationale: This is an exact robustness theorem for a standard highly symmetric family under a parameter introduced to protect mixed vertex-edge localization against one landmark failure. It determines the optimum, classifies every optimum, counts all optima, and reveals a sharp n=8 structural transition between forced one-sided placement and genuinely mixed placement. The result materially sharpens the general existence and construction theory.
